principles.normalization: Uppercase and remove decimal points and surrounding whitespace.
principles.patient_and_hospital_linkage: Never link NRD_VisitLink or HOSP_NRD across calendar years.

exposure.definition: A=1 if any index-admission ICD-10-PCS procedure begins 0FT4; otherwise A=0. Procedure-day validity is audited but does not override the discharge-status exposure.

primary_middle_principal.label: Principal-diagnosis biliary or acute pancreatitis readmission

narrow_principal.label: Principal-diagnosis gallstone disease, cholecystitis, cholangitis, or recurrent biliary acute pancreatitis

wide_any_dx.label: Any-diagnosis broad biliary or acute pancreatitis readmission

ercp_related_inpatient_procedure.label: Endoscopic hepatobiliary or pancreatic duct procedure compatible with inpatient ERCP
ercp_related_inpatient_procedure.limitation: This is not a single validated ERCP gold standard and is never a primary endpoint.

chronic_comorbidity.algorithm: comorbidipy 0.5.0 ICD-10 Quan Charlson and Elixhauser component maps
chronic_comorbidity.input: Index-admission I10_DX2 through I10_DX40 after normalization
chronic_comorbidity.use: Individual chronic components and total scores; acute components are reviewed before modeling.

frailty_proxy.primary_algorithm: comorbidipy 0.5.0 Hospital Frailty Risk Score applied only at age 75 years or older; younger patients receive an explicit not-applicable indicator rather than a zero-risk interpretation.
frailty_proxy.primary_use: Baseline adjustment, age-eligible subgroup description, and exploratory HTE.
frailty_proxy.use: The six-domain count is sensitivity-only and is never labeled a validated frailty index.

harm.procedure_day_based_reintervention: Only procedures occurring after a valid cholecystectomy PRDAY may be temporally labeled post-procedure.
harm.diagnosis_only_complications: Describe as coded co-occurrence because diagnosis onset is unavailable.

model_baseline_domains: within-year prior utilization and observed lookback
